dataset: BRISC 2025 official test split, tumour slices only (GT mask non-empty)

definitions.mass_in_mask: sum of the normalised (sum=1) upsampled map inside the GT mask; uniform baseline equals mask_fraction
definitions.pointing_hit: argmax of the map lies inside the GT mask
definitions.lift_over_mask_fraction: mass_in_mask / mask area, >1 = better than uniform

fusion_weights.note: 2-way softmax over (global, tumour) features; see models/tumor_aware.py AttentionFusion
